cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Cities to analyse. Each city samples apartments for sale and for long-term rent. Katowice is available; its rental market is small, so many groups fall back to city level.

mode.title: What to return
mode.description: yieldReport: gross rental yield per district and room count. scoreListings: a 0–100 deal score for every listing for sale. both: both record types.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Room counts to include in the results. "4+" means four or more rooms.

minScore.title: Minimum deal score
minScore.description: Return only listings with a deal score at or above this value (50 = priced at the median of comparable flats).

samplingMode.sectionDescription: How many listings to sample. Listings are always sampled newest first.
samplingMode.title: Sampling mode
samplingMode.description: perDistrict: the newest listings of every district, for district-level comparisons. city: the newest listings of the whole city; faster, but recent listings only.

maxListingsPerDistrict.title: Listings per district
maxListingsPerDistrict.description: Per-district mode: listings per district and market side. 0 = automatic: 150, or more in cities with few districts (max(150, 1500 ÷ districts)). Ignored in whole-city mode.

maxListingsPerSide.title: Listings per city and side
maxListingsPerSide.description: Whole-city mode: listings for sale and, separately, for rent per city. Ignored in per-district mode.

minSaleSample.title: Minimum sale listings per group
minSaleSample.description: Fewer listings for sale than this in a district and room group: the group falls back to the city level.

minRentSample.title: Minimum rent listings per group
minRentSample.description: Fewer listings for rent than this in a district and room group: the rent estimate falls back to the city level.

onlyNewOrChanged.sectionDescription: Run on a schedule and get only what changed.
onlyNewOrChanged.title: Only new or cheaper listings
onlyNewOrChanged.description: Return only listings that are new or at least 1% cheaper since the last run with the same state key.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Name of the monitoring memory. Use a different key for each watchlist; letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

outputCurrency.title: Sort currency
outputCurrency.description: Currency used to break ties when sorting listings by deal score. Prices are always returned in EUR and in local currency.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy used to reach the listing portal. For Polish residential IPs choose the RESIDENTIAL group and country Poland.
